ICS 93.160
ICS 93.160

1 SCOPE
This standard lays down the proforma for estimating unit rate of concrete used in mechanized construction of river valley projects.
2 REFERENCES
The standard given below contain provisions which through reference in this text constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid. All standards are subject to revision and parties to agreements based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent edition of the standard.
